title: Electropaint 1994
author: David A. Tristram
blurb: The OpenGL screensaver that ran on every idle IRIX screen, recovered by decompiling the MIPS binary: the famous default script with smooth HLS colour. Starts in the IRIS GL look with four-fold mirrors and the intended camera; M switches to the shipped 1994 look.
port: Built from a readable rename of the decompiled source; the verbatim decompilation builds alongside in decomp/.
